PATHWAY MODULATION: Strong evidence of downstream biological effects - endometrial thickness reduction of -2.2 to -1.3 mm during treatment and -3.1 to -0.5 mm during follow-up demonstrates progesterone receptor pathway modulation affecting endometrial biology. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint was met with strong statistical significance (p=0.0001) and large effect size (RD=0.56). Amenorrhea was achieved in significantly more vilaprisan participants vs placebo. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: The drug showed consistent efficacy across the population with 17-20 participants achieving HMB response in vilaprisan groups vs 8 in placebo. No evidence of subgroup-only efficacy. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major trial design issues identified. Sample size of 93 appears adequate given the strong statistical significance achieved.
